text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Rice Shower was,
I decided to take her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother, I'm sorry...
For making you worry...
choice_data_list: Let's get some proper rest today, okay?
Let's get some proper rest today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Big Sister...
For making you worry...
choice_data_list: Let's get some proper rest today, okay?
Let's get some proper rest today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll do that...
Thank you... Onii-sama...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll do that...
Thank you... Onee-sama...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, huh?
Where... am I?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's happening? Is this a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's... so pretty here...
Just like a picture book world...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I'll go for a little run.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ready... go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Hah... Amazing—
It feels like Rice can run like she has wings...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Besides, the sky, the meadows, every single thing is... so very beautiful—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Was that just... a dream?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It was a bit strange, but such a lovely place.
And somehow, my body feels lighter too, maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Feeling fully refreshed, Rice Shower left the nurse's office with a light step.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RUUUUUMBLE...!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eep!?
Wh-What was that sound...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Something black is closing in from over there...!?
It's almost like a wall of ink—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I have to run—!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Th-They're catching up...! I can't――

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ha—
A... dream...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fwehhh...
T-That was so scary...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to shake off the nightmare afterward,
Rice Shower wasn't able to get enough rest...
